record.title_md: [Open problem: Combinatorial algorithm for MIS on perfect graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/1907.01083)
record.paper: The independent set problem is FPT for even-hole-free graphs

dossier_meta.paper: The independent set problem is FPT for even-hole-free graphs
dossier_meta.catalog_title: Open problem: Combinatorial algorithm for MIS on perfect graphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: It remains an open question to find a combinatorial algorithm for the maximum independent set problem on perfect graphs. In fact, we do not even have a combinatorial FPT algorithm for the maximum independent set problem on perfect graphs.
dossier_meta.context_text: The maximum independent set problem on perfect graphs is solvable in polynomial time via the ellipsoid method, but a combinatorial algorithm (i.e., one not relying on the ellipsoid method) is unknown. This is mentioned as a side remark motivating the study of related graph classes.
